craft_notes: Sthāyin: both-ways homage (knower and known honored). Rows: row 2 (seen→homage). Close: me (mahyaṃ as landing: homage ends at ME too). Rejected: 'disciple' for devotee — kept devotee (bhakta precise); 'realize' for seen — kept seen (samprekṣya as beheld).

lines: Of your devotee, who knows your form well, now again —
having seen you as the self's own shape: homage to you, homage to me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktasya sajñātabhavadrūpasyatha me punaḥ | tvāmātmarūpaṃ samprekṣya tubhyaṃ mahyaṃ namo namaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What does the devotee declare? → Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage goes to you and to me — knower and known each honored.
c1_essence: Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage to you and to me.
